paite: Huan Israel suante'n Mizpah khua ah, i lak ua mi kuamah in i tanute uh Benjamin suante zi ding in i pe kei ding uh, chi in akichiam uhi.
heading: Benjaminte Zi Ding

paite: Bethel ah mipite ahoh ua, Pathian ma ah nitak tan in atu ua, a-awte uh suah in akap vongvong uhi.
Amau bel, "Aw TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, bangchidan ahia Israelte lak a hichibang thil ahong om?" achi uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in zingkhang in athou ua, huai ah maitam abawl ua, halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.

Israel suante'n, Israel nam tengteng lak a TOUPA kiang a paikhawm pawl lak a va tel tei lou kuate ahi ua? achi uh. Mizpah a TOUPA kiang ava hoh lou peuhmahte bel, thah ngeingei ding ahi, chi in ana kichiamta uhi.
Israel suante a-unaupa uh Benjamin suante tungthu ah akisik ua, "Tuni in Israel suante lak ah nam khat satkhiak ahita, achi uhi.
A-omsunte a ding in azi ding uh bangchi in i hihta ding ua? I tanute uh lah azi ding ua neisak lou ding in TOUPA min lou in i na kichiamta ngal ua,” achi uhi.
Amau achi ua, Mizpah a TOUPA kiang a hong paitou lou Israel namte lak ah a-om hia? Ngai in, kikhawm pawl omna mun ah Jabesh-gilead mite lak ah khat lel leng ahong hoh kei uhi.
Mite akisim uleh, ngai in, Jabesh-gilead gam a omte khat lel leng ana omta kei uhi.
Omkhawmte'n mihangsan hoih ngen singkhat-le-sangnih asawl uhi. "Kuan unla, Jabesh-gilead gam a omte numei leh atanu neute uh toh namsau in va satlum vek un.
Na hihdan ding uh hichibang ahi. Mi tengteng leh numei, pasal kithuahpih khinsa peuhmah hihmangthang vek un,” chi in thu apia uhi.
Jabesh-gilead gam a omte lak ah nungak zali, pasal kithuahpih ngei het louh amu uhi. Huchi in a-omna uh Shiloh ah api ua, huai tuh Kanaan gam a om ahi.
Omkhawm tengteng in mi asawl ua, Rimmon suangpi a om Benjamin suante ava houpih ua, kilemna bawl ding in asam uhi.
Huaitak in Benjamin pawl ahong nawn ua; Jabesh-gilead gam a numei ahawite uh azi ding un apia uhi. Huchi in leng akiching kei lai uhi.
Israel nam lak a TOUPA'N kihih- tuamna ana bawl ziak in mite, Benjamin suante tungthu ah akisik uhi.
Huchi in omkhawmte upate'n, "Adamlaite zi ding bang i chih ding ua? Benjamin suante lak a numeite lah hihmang ahita ngal ua?" achi uhi.
"Amau Israel nam hihmanlouhna ding in Benjamin suan omsunte bangchi in suan i neisak ding ua?
I tanute uh lah azi un i neisak thei ngal kei ua," achi uhi. Israel suante'n, "Kuapeuh Benjamin suante zi dia neisak peuhmah hamsiat in om uhen," chi in akichiam uhi.
Amau, "Ngai un, Bethel mallam, Bethel a pan Shekem zotna lamlian suahlam pang a Lebonah simlam a om Shiloh ah kum sim in TOUPA a ding in ankuangluina a-om,” achi uhi.
Amau Benjamin suante kiang ah, "Va hoh unla, grep mun ah va guktan un;
Na en unla, ngai un, Shiloh a nungakte lamna a lam dia ahong pawt uleh, grep mun a pan hong pawt unla, Shiloh nungakte na zi ding un man chiat unla, Benjaminte gam ah paipih un.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, apate uh hiam, asanggampate uh hiam kalh dia i kiang ua ahong uleh, akiang uah, hon hehpih un. Kidouna sung in lah zi ka guan thei kei uh. Nou lah na tanute uh na piak thoh un hilou a, kichiamna a moh tang lou ding na hi uh," ka chi ding uh, achi uhi.
Benjamin suante'n huchibang in ahih uhi. Lampawlte lak a mi amau zah chiat zi ding in aman ua, apaimangpihta uhi. Huchi in agam uah apai ua, khopite apuah nawn ua, huai ah atengta uhi.
Huaitak in huai a pan Israel suante bel amau chichi leh amau namnam in akihuituam nawn ua, huai nungsiah amau gam chiat ah apai nawn uhi.
Huai lai in Israelte lak ah kumpipa a-om kei a; michih in ama mitmuh a dik asak bang in ahih chiat uhi.
